_doc: Retro looks for the 3D view (#503), an experiment behind ?look=snes or ?look=ps1 (src/render3d/lookRetro.ts), tuned live in its panel. pixel: CSS pixels per chunky pixel (rounded to whole screen pixels); colours: 'palette' (the nearest of the first paletteSize colours picked from palette, in OKLab) or 'bits' (bits per channel); dither: the dither's spread in sRGB (0 to 1); pattern: off, bayer2, bayer4, bayer8 or ps1 (the PlayStation's 4x4 table); outlines: dark lines where depth jumps (silhouette: how far behind the neighbour must be, as a share of the distance) or bends (crease, on 1/depth, 0 off, drawn to creaseRange metres), and how dark each makes the pixel; brightness, contrast, saturation: applied before the colours are reduced; wobble: snap vertices to a coarse screen grid, this many steps across the screen's height (0 off; takes effect on reload).
